payload.name: Include all explicit reasons in preference extraction
payload.description: When extracting a profile or preference memory, if the source explicitly gives multiple reasons for liking, disliking, or choosing something, include all distinct reasons in the memory content.
content: During extraction, if a speaker explicitly lists multiple reasons or traits for a preference or choice, capture every distinct reason in the candidate memory content; do not drop any reason because another reason seems more salient.
Before adding or updating a profile/preference memory, check the source message for every stated reason and ensure the memory content reflects all of them.

solves: The extraction stage sometimes records only a subset of explicitly stated reasons for a preference, so later questions about omitted reasons cannot be answered from memory. This rule applies whenever a source message lists multiple distinct reasons or traits for a like/dislike or choice: the extracted profile memory must include every explicit reason.
